specialist-gloves-buckshot.name: ★ Specialist Gloves | Buckshot
specialist-gloves-buckshot.desc: Durable, breathable, and stylish; these gloves are designed to take (and give) a beating. These practical gloves would be at home in a hunting blind.

specialist-gloves-crimson-kimono.name: ★ Specialist Gloves | Crimson Kimono
specialist-gloves-crimson-kimono.desc:
Durable, breathable, and stylish; these gloves are designed to take (and give) a beating. This pair of black gloves has been accented with a stark red diamond pattern.

Start seeing red

broken-fang-gloves-unhinged.name: ★ Broken Fang Gloves | Unhinged
broken-fang-gloves-unhinged.desc: These fingerless gloves have been decorated with metal studs and the Operation Broken Fang logo.

ak-47-panthera-onca.name: AK-47 | Panthera onca
ak-47-panthera-onca.desc:
Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. The wood on the stock and handguard feature beautiful carvings, often stealing attention from the custom painted jaguar on the side.

Who said you can't change your spots?

ak-47-first-class.name: AK-47 | First Class
ak-47-first-class.desc:
Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. Its stock has been wrapped in green leather.

Mimosa not included

ak-47-rat-rod.name: AK-47 | Rat Rod
ak-47-rat-rod.desc:
Powerful and reliable, the AK-47 is one of the most popular assault rifles in the world. It is most deadly in short, controlled bursts of fire. Recovered from a wasteland junkyard, its original blue topcoat has been painted over, etched into, and weathered away.

Nowhere to run

cz75-auto-emerald-quartz.name: CZ75-Auto | Emerald Quartz
cz75-auto-emerald-quartz.desc:
A fully automatic variant of the CZ75, the CZ75-Auto is the ideal short-term choice for turning the tables and gaining your opponents weapon. But with very little ammo in the magazine, strong trigger discipline is required. It has been painted with green metallic paint and uses a crystallizing mask to create a pattern.

Everyone wants to make an impact

desert-eagle-code-red.name: Desert Eagle | Code Red
desert-eagle-code-red.desc:
As expensive as it is powerful, the Desert Eagle is an iconic pistol that is difficult to master but surprisingly accurate at long range. A custom paint job with a bright red base and white detailing has been applied.

Man your stations

dual-berettas-sweet-little-angels.name: Dual Berettas | Sweet Little Angels
dual-berettas-sweet-little-angels.desc:
Firing two large-mag Berettas at once will lower accuracy and increase load times. On the bright side, you'll get to fire two large-mag Berettas at once. Two cherubs have been custom painted over a bright-colored graffiti base.

Aww, look how… precious they are

dual-berettas-marina.name: Dual Berettas | Marina
dual-berettas-marina.desc:
Firing two large-mag Berettas at once will lower accuracy and increase load times. On the bright side, you'll get to fire two large-mag Berettas at once. It has been painted with a hydrographic in a contrasting yellow and blue pattern.

Some people will call you a hero... others a villain

famas-corp-defense.name: FAMAS | Corp Defense
famas-corp-defense.desc:
A cheap option for cash-strapped players, the FAMAS effectively fills the niche between more expensive rifles and the less-effective SMGs. It has been custom painted in black and red.

Suit and sunglasses sold separately

famas-cyanospatter.name: FAMAS | Cyanospatter
famas-cyanospatter.desc: A cheap option for cash-strapped players, the FAMAS effectively fills the niche between more expensive rifles and the less-effective SMGs. It has been painted in a marbleized pattern.

famas-macabre.name: FAMAS | Macabre
famas-macabre.desc:
A cheap option for cash-strapped players, the FAMAS effectively fills the niche between more expensive rifles and the less-effective SMGs. It has been spray painted with a green design over a yellow undercoat.

A gruesome discovery

five-seven-autumn-thicket.name: Five-SeveN | Autumn Thicket
five-seven-autumn-thicket.desc:
Highly accurate and armor-piercing, the pricy Five-Seven is a slow-loader that compensates with a generous 20-round magazine and forgiving recoil. A brown pattern of branches has been applied.

Watch where you step

five-seven-orange-peel.name: Five-SeveN | Orange Peel
five-seven-orange-peel.desc:
Highly accurate and armor-piercing, the pricy Five-Seven is a slow-loader that compensates with a generous 20-round magazine and forgiving recoil. It has been spray-painted using a tangle of masking tape as a stencil.

True power is demonstrated with subtle application

galil-ar-sky-mandala.name: Galil AR | Sky Mandala
galil-ar-sky-mandala.desc:
A less expensive option among the terrorist-exclusive assault rifles, the Galil AR is a serviceable weapon in medium to long-range combat. A multicolored mandala pattern has been applied.

It's about the journey

glock-18-winterized.name: Glock-18 | Winterized
glock-18-winterized.desc:
The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. It has been custom painted with a military camouflage in a winter colorway.

Freeze!

glock-18-death-rattle.name: Glock-18 | Death Rattle
glock-18-death-rattle.desc:
The Glock 18 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents and is capable of firing three-round bursts. It has been painted with a snakeskin patterned hydrographic.

I know you don't believe in the cause...and when I expose you, Valeria will have your head - The Shield and The Serpent Part 1

p2000-coach-class.name: P2000 | Coach Class
p2000-coach-class.desc:
Accurate and controllable, the German-made P2000 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents. It has been painted with a plaid hydrographic and parts of the grip have been wrapped in brown leather.

It's not fancy, but it gets you where you need to go

p2000-turf.name: P2000 | Turf
p2000-turf.desc:
Accurate and controllable, the German-made P2000 is a serviceable first-round pistol that works best against unarmored opponents. The grip and slide have been painted metallic green.

The grass is always redder on the opposing side

butterfly-knife-crimson-web.name: ★ Butterfly Knife | Crimson Web
butterfly-knife-crimson-web.desc:
This is a custom-designed balisong, commonly known as a butterfly knife. The defining characteristic of this weapon is the fan-like opening of a freely pivoting blade, allowing rapid deployment or concealment. As a result, butterfly knives are outlawed in many countries. It has been painted using a spider web-patterned hydrographic over a red base coat and finished with a semi-gloss topcoat.

Be careful where you walk, you never know where the web is spread

butterfly-knife-night.name: ★ Butterfly Knife | Night
butterfly-knife-night.desc:
This is a custom-designed balisong, commonly known as a butterfly knife. The defining characteristic of this weapon is the fan-like opening of a freely pivoting blade, allowing rapid deployment or concealment. As a result, butterfly knives are outlawed in many countries. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a night ops color scheme.

It's the whisper of the wind... it's the bite at your neck

butterfly-knife-safari-mesh.name: ★ Butterfly Knife | Safari Mesh
butterfly-knife-safari-mesh.desc:
This is a custom-designed balisong, commonly known as a butterfly knife. The defining characteristic of this weapon is the fan-like opening of a freely pivoting blade, allowing rapid deployment or concealment. As a result, butterfly knives are outlawed in many countries. It has been spray-painted using mesh fencing and cardboard cutouts as stencils.

A predator is a predator, no matter the environment

survival-knife-doppler-sapphire.name: ★ Survival Knife | Doppler
survival-knife-doppler-sapphire.desc:
This multi-purpose tactical knife features a serrated edge for ripping through coarse material like bone or fiber, plus a sharp gutting hook. The composite material handle is bolted to the blade with hex nuts. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

survival-knife-forest-ddpat.name: ★ Survival Knife | Forest DDPAT
survival-knife-forest-ddpat.desc:
This multi-purpose tactical knife features a serrated edge for ripping through coarse material like bone or fiber, plus a sharp gutting hook. The composite material handle is bolted to the blade with hex nuts. It has been painted using a Digital Disruptive Pattern (DDPAT) hydrographic.

By the time you're close enough to notice the pixels it's already too late

paracord-knife-doppler-phase-2.name: ★ Paracord Knife | Doppler
paracord-knife-doppler-phase-2.desc:
This fixed-blade survival knife is designed to withstand being used as both a weapon and a tool, such as for setting traps, hunting animals or cutting foliage. The handle is wrapped in a length of multi-purpose paracord. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

Getting lost in its color can prove fatal

paracord-knife-ultraviolet.name: ★ Paracord Knife | Ultraviolet
paracord-knife-ultraviolet.desc:
This fixed-blade survival knife is designed to withstand being used as both a weapon and a tool, such as for setting traps, hunting animals or cutting foliage. The handle is wrapped in a length of multi-purpose paracord. It has individual parts spray-painted solid colors in a black and purple color scheme.

Elegant design paired with brutal intent

falchion-knife-gamma-doppler-emerald.name: ★ Falchion Knife | Gamma Doppler
falchion-knife-gamma-doppler-emerald.desc: A modern homage to a falchion sword, this clip point blade has a curved edge. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

falchion-knife-scorched.name: ★ Falchion Knife | Scorched
falchion-knife-scorched.desc:
A modern homage to a falchion sword, this clip point blade has a curved edge. It has been spray-painted in a sun-dappled pattern.

The Phoenix is not a symbol of destruction... it's a symbol of rebirth - Valeria Jenner, Revolutionary

flip-knife-urban-masked.name: ★ Flip Knife | Urban Masked
flip-knife-urban-masked.desc:
Flip knives sport a Persian-style back-swept blade with an acute point.  While the point itself may be fragile, the overall design of the flip knife's design is surprisingly durable. It has been spray-painted using a tangle of masking tape as a stencil.

True power is demonstrated with subtle application

gut-knife-black-laminate.name: ★ Gut Knife | Black Laminate
gut-knife-black-laminate.desc: The most notable feature of a gut knife is the gut hook on the spine of the blade.  Originally popularized as an aid for field dressing game, the gut hook is also effective at  cutting through fibrous materials like rope, webbing, or safety belts with ease. It has been stonewashed and given a black laminate handle.

kukri-knife-scorched.name: ★ Kukri Knife | Scorched
kukri-knife-scorched.desc:
Used in traditional rituals, such as weddings or stabbings. It has been spray-painted in a sun-dappled pattern.

The Phoenix is not a symbol of destruction... it's a symbol of rebirth - Valeria Jenner, Revolutionary

m9-bayonet-gamma-doppler-phase-1.name: ★ M9 Bayonet | Gamma Doppler
m9-bayonet-gamma-doppler-phase-1.desc: This is the M-9 bayonet.  Originally intended to be mounted on a rifle, it is also well suited to close-quarters combat. It has been painted with black and silver metallic paints using a marbleizing medium, then candy coated.

m9-bayonet-stained.name: ★ M9 Bayonet | Stained
m9-bayonet-stained.desc:
This is the M-9 bayonet.  Originally intended to be mounted on a rifle, it is also well suited to close-quarters combat. It has been given a forced patina using lemon and mustard dripped onto the surface.

If you think it's messy now, wait until you see it under a blacklight

skeleton-knife-stained.name: ★ Skeleton Knife | Stained
skeleton-knife-stained.desc:
This skeletonized-tang knife has been taped at the handle for improved grip. The hole allows a finger to be threaded through for stability and safety. It has been given a forced patina using lemon and mustard dripped onto the surface.

If you think it's messy now, wait until you see it under a blacklight

stiletto-knife-scorched.name: ★ Stiletto Knife | Scorched
stiletto-knife-scorched.desc:
Historically a focal point of contention and even regulation, this Italian-style stiletto switchblade knife features a spring-loaded blade that can be deployed almost instantly with the push of a release catch. It has been spray-painted in a sun-dappled pattern.

The Phoenix is not a symbol of destruction... it's a symbol of rebirth - Valeria Jenner, Revolutionary

talon-knife-damascus-steel.name: ★ Talon Knife | Damascus Steel
talon-knife-damascus-steel.desc: This ivory-handled karambit features brass rivets and saw-tooth ridges, so it cuts on the way in, and tears on the way out. It has some damascus steel parts.

m249-sleet.name: M249 | Sleet
m249-sleet.desc:
A strong open-area LMG, the M249 is the perfect choice for players willing to trade a slow fire rate for increased accuracy and a high ammo capacity. An angular grayscale pattern has been applied.

Rich interiors suited for rough exteriors

m249-predator.name: M249 | Predator
m249-predator.desc: A strong open-area LMG, the M249 is the perfect choice for players willing to trade a slow fire rate for increased accuracy and a high ammo capacity. It has been spray-painted in a zebra stripe pattern.

m4a4-jungle-tiger.name: M4A4 | Jungle Tiger
m4a4-jungle-tiger.desc: More accurate but less damaging than its AK-47 counterpart, the M4A4 is the full-auto assault rifle of choice for CTs. It has been painted using a jungle tiger hydrographic.

m4a1-s-player-two.name: M4A1-S | Player Two
m4a1-s-player-two.desc:
With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy. It has been custom painted with bright colors and features animated versions of a GIGN CT and Pop Dog.

Press Start...

m4a1-s-mud-spec.name: M4A1-S | Mud-Spec
m4a1-s-mud-spec.desc:
With a smaller magazine than its unmuffled counterpart, the silenced M4A1 provides quieter shots with less recoil and better accuracy. A custom black and brown camouflage has been applied.

Backup has arrived

mac-10-gold-brick.name: MAC-10 | Gold Brick
mac-10-gold-brick.desc:
Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. Its gold finish shimmers in the light, highlighting every beautiful imperfection on the weapon.

All that glitters...

mac-10-light-box.name: MAC-10 | Light Box
mac-10-light-box.desc:
Essentially a box that bullets come out of, the MAC-10 SMG boasts a high rate of fire, with poor spread accuracy and high recoil as trade-offs. It has been custom painted to appear as if you are looking into the back of the MAC-10.

Custom built

mag-7-chainmail.name: MAG-7 | Chainmail
mag-7-chainmail.desc:
The CT-exclusive Mag-7 delivers a devastating amount of damage at close range. Its rapid magazine-style reloads make it a great tactical choice. It has been painted with a semi-transparent hydrographic in a chainmail pattern over a silver base coat.

Of all the members of The Phoenix, none are more loyal to Valeria than her bodyguard Naomi

mp7-whiteout.name: MP7 | Whiteout
mp7-whiteout.desc:
Versatile but expensive, the German-made MP7 SMG is the perfect choice for high-impact close-range combat. It is spray-painted all white.

It looks pure, but looks can be deceiving

nova-army-sheen.name: Nova | Army Sheen
nova-army-sheen.desc:
The Nova's rock-bottom price tag makes it a great ambush weapon for a cash-strapped team. It has been covered in a metallic foil stamped with a camouflage pattern.

Remember your training

p250-forest-night.name: P250 | Forest Night
p250-forest-night.desc:
A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. It has been painted using a forest camouflage hydrographic.

The woods can be a dangerous place... never travel alone

p250-red-tide.name: P250 | Red Tide
p250-red-tide.desc:
A low-recoil firearm with a high rate of fire, the P250 is a relatively inexpensive choice against armored opponents. A wine and beige-colored coral pattern has been applied.

Nature laughed, for it created something we couldn't dream possible

p90-sand-spray.name: P90 | Sand Spray
p90-sand-spray.desc:
Easily recognizable for its unique bullpup design, the P90 is a great weapon to shoot on the move due to its high-capacity magazine and low recoil. It has been spray-painted freehand with short, thick lines in contrasting colors.

Perfect for the insurgent on the go

sawed-off-copper.name: Sawed-Off | Copper
sawed-off-copper.desc: The classic Sawed-Off deals very heavy close-range damage, but with its low accuracy, high spread and slow rate of fire, you'd better kill what you hit. It has been copper plated.

scar-20-blueprint.name: SCAR-20 | Blueprint
scar-20-blueprint.desc:
The SCAR-20 is a semi-automatic sniper rifle that trades a high rate of fire and powerful long-distance damage for sluggish movement speed and big price tag. It has been hand painted using a blue theme to resemble an architect's blueprint.

The best-laid plans are drawn to scale

zeus-x27-swamp-ddpat.name: Zeus x27 | Swamp DDPAT
zeus-x27-swamp-ddpat.desc:
Perfect for close-range ambushes and enclosed area encounters, the rechargeable x27 Zeus is capable of incapacitating an enemy in a single hit. A green and sand-colored hydrographic digital camo pattern has been applied.

Look twice, then look again

tec-9-sandstorm.name: Tec-9 | Sandstorm
tec-9-sandstorm.desc:
An ideal pistol for the Terrorist on the move, the Tec-9 is lethal in close quarters and features a high magazine capacity. It has been painted using a hydrographic in a purple and beige graphic design.

It'll take more than a tarp to protect you

ump-45-mechanism.name: UMP-45 | Mechanism
ump-45-mechanism.desc:
The misunderstood middle child of the SMG family, the UMP45's small magazine is the only drawback to an otherwise versatile close-quarters automatic. An anodized pattern of engine components has been applied.

"It doesn't look good..."

xm1014-bone-machine.name: XM1014 | Bone Machine
xm1014-bone-machine.desc: The XM1014 is a powerful fully automatic shotgun that justifies its heftier price tag with the ability to paint a room with lead fast. It has been chromed then overlayed with a semi transparent hydrographic pattern of nuclear skulls and bones.

talon-knife.name: ★ Talon Knife
talon-knife.desc: This ivory-handled karambit features brass rivets and saw-tooth ridges, so it cuts on the way in, and tears on the way out.
